svg.title: Garage (tp::garage): upgrades as parameter changes, choices between parts, the career's money

g.text: Garage (tp::garage): upgrades as parameter changes, choices between parts, the career's money
+validate(const Catalogue&, const vehicle::Params&, const rules::ClassRules&) : optional<ParamError>
+equipped(const vehicle::Params&, const Catalogue&, const Career&) : optional<vehicle::Params>
level 0 of every upgrade is the tractor the player starts with;
each level sets its part's value outright, so parts never interact
and validate() checks each level with the others at their top.
The top levels reach the class's limits (NTTO standard 3.5 t:
85 hp at the PTO, 2700 rpm unloaded, 3500 kg, the hitch at 0.5 m)
alternatives owned side by side, one fitted: the first comes with
the tractor, another is bought once and fitted or taken off for
nothing. equipped() puts the fitted ones in, then the upgrades
that count; validate() tries every combination of alternatives
